title_ar: غرفة زينة للسيدة بلمسة موكا وعاج
scene_en: Quiet-luxury ladies' dressing room 4.5x4 m, 3 m ceiling: a full-width open wardrobe on the north wall with ivory-oak shelving and soft LED strips, a floating vanity desk on the south wall with an oak-framed mirror above it and a round upholstered stool, a low accessories island with drawers in the centre topped by a mother-of-pearl vase, a cream boucle chaise along the west wall, walls in Jazeera WH-2108 White Mocha, floor in RAK Hard Wood Ivory wood-look planks, beige sheer curtains on the east window for privacy, a slim gypsum mashrabiya-pattern panel framing the vanity niche, soft golden evening light with warm cove lighting
view_en: Wide shot from the west door looking east toward the sheer-curtained window, wardrobe on the left and vanity on the right
